definition.description: Presence of a documented history of community-acquired pneumonia.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has a documented diagnosis, history, or hospitalization for community-acquired pneumonia from the medical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If there is no mention of community-acquired pneumonia in the record, represent as 'Absent'.
definition.name: community_acquired_pneumonia_presence

definition.description: The total number of distinct comorbid medical conditions documented in the patient's pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Count the number of unique diagnosed medical conditions present in the patient record, excluding the primary diagnosis for which the patient is being treated.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 0 if no comorbidities are documented; represent as null if the record is missing or unable to be parsed.
definition.name: comorbidities

definition.description: The overall clinical interpretation of the patient's complete blood count (CBC) result.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the qualitative interpretation (e.g., normal or abnormal) of the complete blood count panel from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no CBC result or interpretation is documented.
definition.name: complete_blood_count_result

definition.description: Overall qualitative interpretation of the comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the global assessment of the comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP) result, typically documented as 'normal' or 'abnormal'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no comprehensive metabolic panel result or interpretation is documented in the record.
definition.name: comprehensive_metabolic_panel_result

definition.description: Presence of confusion as a clinical symptom.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if confusion is documented as a symptom in the patient's clinical record, such as in the chief complaint or history of present illness.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'absent' if not mentioned or explicitly denied in the record.
definition.name: confusion_present

definition.description: The concentration of the iodinated contrast agent used during imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the iodine concentration of the contrast agent from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the concentration is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: contrast_agent_concentration

definition.description: The presence of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) prior to the start of treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the patient has a documented diagnosis of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) within the past medical history, problem list, or clinical assessment sections of the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of COPD or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: copd_presence

definition.description: The severity level of the patient's chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the clinician-reported severity grade for COPD (e.g., 'mild', 'moderate', 'severe', or 'very severe') from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no specific severity grade is documented.
definition.name: copd_severity

definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has a documented diagnosis of coronary artery disease (CAD) from the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the diagnosis is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as 'Absent'.
definition.name: coronary_artery_disease

definition.description: Presence of cough at the pretreatment baseline
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether cough is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment record. Documentation of 'dry', 'productive', 'non-productive', 'persistent', or 'intermittent' cough is considered 'present'. Documentation of 'denies cough', 'no cough', or 'absence of cough' is considered 'absent'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if cough status is not mentioned or is ambiguous.
definition.name: cough_presence

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
